0022600191.text: The New York Knicks (4-4, 7th in the East) visit the Cleveland Cavaliers (4-4, 6th in the East), with New York 1-2 on the road, Cleveland 3-1 at home, the Knicks on a two-game winning streak, and the Cavaliers on a two-game losing streak. New York is without Josh Hart, who is out with an ankle injury, while Cleveland is missing Jarrett Allen (knee) and Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain). The teams have not met yet this season, but the Knicks won the 2025-26 season series 2-1 and the 2025-26 playoff series 4-0, most recently a 130-93 win in Cleveland on May 25.
